bounded_interface_domain: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
source_record.native_common_basis: Provide shared platform capabilities when they reduce total consumer and operator burden while preserving useful choice and feedback.
common_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Root literal analytical arguments from the complete selected native bodies and eight executed finite discriminators. One bounded NASA standard corroborates scoped distinctions, not universal authority requirements or causal effect sizes. No new property, field experiment, whole-synthesis completion or independent acceptance.

positive_controls.argument: A suitable common capability can provide consistent artifact identity, impact records or preauthorized checks to the consumer's change decision, reducing duplicated work when total burden is lower.
A suitable platform can supply reproducible item identity and criterion-linked results as acceptance inputs without duplicating infrastructure across consumers.
Versioned common evidence and controlled platform configuration can supply reusable scoped inputs, subject to the actual consumer configuration and applicable credit rules.
A fit-for-purpose common service can give reviewers controlled access to exact artifacts and reproducible analysis, reducing repeated setup where that service respects challenge needs.
The platform can supply controlled evidence and declared shared-service assumptions for the specific claim, including common failure modes that consumer-local views miss.
A validated common control capability offers an actual alternative to repeated per-consumer implementation, with operator, consumer, migration and exception costs included.
A suitable shared service can provide controlled versions, access and interoperable representations, supplying infrastructure for the model's declared authority and reconciliation work.
The platform can supply current configuration evidence and enforce a bounded stop or isolation action, contributing to the risk owner's decision and response capacity.

receiving_native_meaning.criterion: Its authority, version, semantics, access and reconciliation with actual systems are adequate for the decisions made from it.

member_to_common_premise.actual_object: A common digital engineering environment actually used to host or exchange authoritative models for several consumers.
member_to_common_premise.literal_bridge: A suitable shared service can provide controlled versions, access and interoperable representations, supplying infrastructure for the model's declared authority and reconciliation work.

member_to_premise_evidence.shared_question_or_object: An operational risk decision whose actual safeguards, evidence or stop capability are supplied by a shared platform.

source.bearer: Repeated infrastructure needs across consumers with sufficiently common requirements.
source.criterion: Provide shared platform capabilities when they reduce total consumer and operator burden while preserving useful choice and feedback.

receiver.bearer: A consequential residual-risk and operational decision
receiver.criterion: An appropriately empowered actor accepts or rejects the stated residual risk with current evidence and a defined operating boundary.

guard: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: The platform can supply current configuration evidence and enforce a bounded stop or isolation action, contributing to the risk owner's decision and response capacity.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: The platform can supply current configuration evidence and enforce a bounded stop or isolation action, contributing to the risk owner's decision and response capacity.
premises_supplied: The platform can supply current configuration evidence and enforce a bounded stop or isolation action, contributing to the risk owner's decision and response capacity.
premises_remaining: An appropriately empowered actor accepts or rejects the stated residual risk with current evidence and a defined operating boundary.
The receiver-native conditions not established by the literal partial contribution, including actual net benefit and any remaining authority or evidence.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: A platform administrator can toggle deployment but lacks authority to accept the consumer's residual risk; technical capability is not permission.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: A platform administrator can toggle deployment but lacks authority to accept the consumer's residual risk; technical capability is not permission.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: The stated common object or actual receiving use is known absent; if merely unknown, no negative is inferred.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen affected directions on changed responsibilities, delegation, expiry, issuer/basis, configuration, model correspondence, critical knowledge, platform consumers or costs, current evidence, source correction or counterexample. Known absence of this particular common use defeats the guarded instance, not every other possible material use; an unestablished guard is not a global negative.
